annotation: Beitrag zur Sammlung »The Progress of English Poetry« (INr 130152, Obj 15)
incipit_statement: Look well about yee that lovers bee, / Let not your lusts lead you to dotage, / Be not enamoured on all things the ye see
preferred_title: A ballad, warning men to beware of deceitful women.
